entries.purpose: Poll the inherited-pipe parent readiness barrier while detecting early process exit.
callers: Inline future passed to tokio::time::timeout by spawn_inherited_pipe_fixture.
inputs: Borrowed readiness marker path and mutable supervised child.
entries.output: Result<(), String> before the outer 60-second timeout mapping.
sideEffects: Checks readiness-path file metadata, polls child exit status, and yields with 25 ms Tokio sleeps.
errors: Returns a try_wait error or an error containing the early child exit status; the enclosing timeout supplies the 60-second timeout error.
ownership: Borrows the marker path and child only for this bounded future; the enclosing helper retains child and fixture-root ownership.
locks: No mutex or process-job lock is acquired.
entries.cancellation: No independent cancellation select; the outer timeout bounds the poll, and every failure branch in the enclosing helper cancels and reaps the child before fixture cleanup.
invariants: The helper returns success only after both parent setup and descendant readiness are complete, so behavior deadlines exclude PowerShell/Add-Type startup.
An early exit cannot be mistaken for readiness.
tests: Indirectly exercised by the inherited-pipe process tests; current execution is pending root.
